note: Snakebite's boards (2026-11-07, snakes-short): the short layouts of the owner's approved pictures A and C. ladders are [foot, top], snakes [head, tail], squares 1 to 100 on the zigzag (1 bottom left, 100 top left). Every layout keeps short_rules.js; a layout is dealt in its left-right mirror too where mirror is true (both orientations then play a good length of game, and the app plans both). layouts.js deals a game one board of this file by the game's seed. The first layout is the lobby's picture.

layouts.name: Short 1
layouts.sub: eight ladders (most lean a column) and eight serpents, each across two or three rows and none touching another; a lone player needs 31 turns (32 in its mirror)
layouts.method: made by tools/make-short-layouts.js (rules in short_rules.js) and planned by the app's Tools/snakes_layouts.py, which holds every serpent's S-curve and every number to the same clearances
